children: Australia has a concentration risk hiding in plain sight with around 68% of household wealth tied up in residential property, says Marc Jocum, a senior investment strategist at Global X ETFs. While rising property prices previously made that concentration appear to be a strength, he notes when home prices fall and borrowing costs rise, the same concentration can amplify financial stress. With home prices in decline for five consecutive months, mortgage stress is a major reason Australians are seeking financial help, he says. Some lenders are reporting deterioration in 90-plus-day arrears. While it is too early to call this a housing or mortgage crisis, he notes these signals are worth watching. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
